_about: Where the source for every binary in these images comes from, at the exact pinned version. Copied into each image at /licenses/sources.json; bin/mirror-sources.py downloads every 'source' URL for a release. tests/test_licensing.py fails if a Dockerfile pin is missing here, so a version bump must update this file.
